verdict.rationale: Rainforest's API supports the core seller-operations lifecycle programmatically — creating merchants (create_merchant), driving onboarding via API/component/portal options, and surfacing requirements-due states like 'Needs Information' via webhooks — with scoped credentials in the form of long-lived API keys and short-lived component sessions. However, there is no evidence of an MCP server or any AI-agent-specific surface; this is a standard REST/webhook integration, not an agent-oriented interface. Missing for 10: MCP server/tool-calling surface, explicit agent-scoped credential model, and any agent-specific onboarding automation documentation.
